login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the work account your administrator created for you.
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask a system administrator to reset it.
login.invalid: That email and password don't match an active account.
login.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
login.failed: Couldn't sign you in. Try again.
login.blurb: Clients, people, cases, billing and margin in one controlled place.
login.monitored: Internal system. Access is monitored and audited.

verify.title: Two-factor check
verify.totpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
verify.backupHint: Enter one of your saved backup codes.
verify.invalid: That code isn't valid. Try again.
verify.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
verify.useBackup: Lost your device? Use a backup code

setup.passwordNotice: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose a new one to continue.
setup.mfaNotice: Your role handles sensitive data, so two-factor authentication is required before you can continue.

security.title: Security
security.appBody: Use Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password to generate a code each time you sign in.
security.step1: 1. Scan the code with your authenticator app.
security.codeMismatch: That code didn't match. Check your app's clock and try the newest code.
security.backupBody: Save these backup codes somewhere safe. Each one works once if you lose your phone. They won't be shown again.
security.turnOffBody: Your account will only be protected by your password.
security.passwordBody: Changing it signs you out on your other devices.
security.passwordBodyRequired: Replace the temporary password you were given.

overview.activityAll: Latest audited events across the system
overview.nothingHint: Activity will appear here as work happens.
overview.assigned: {count, plural, =1 {1 assigned client} other {# assigned clients}}
overview.trendHint: The 12 months up to the selected month, before VAT, in SAR.
overview.prioritiesHint: Your tasks due today or late.
overview.attentionHint: Based on late payments, breached cases and margin. Updated hourly.
overview.definitionsHint: The same definitions apply in reports and exports.
overview.def_revenue: Issued invoices before VAT, less credit notes. Drafts and voids don't count.
overview.def_directCost: Payroll cost plus approved direct expenses.
overview.def_margin: Contribution as a share of revenue.
overview.def_netProfit: Contribution minus approved overhead. Shown only for the whole company.
overview.def_receivables: Issued invoices minus payments and credit notes applied to them.

users.title: Users
users.description: People who can sign in to EntityGate, and what they're allowed to do.
users.emptyBody: Try a different search or clear the status filter.
users.createBody: They'll get a temporary password to sign in with.
users.secretBody: Share this temporary password privately. It won't be shown again.
users.resetBody: Signs them out everywhere and issues a new temporary password.
users.suspendBody: Ends their sessions immediately. History is kept.
users.reactivateBody: Allow this person to sign in again.
users.twoFactorResetBody: For a lost device. Signs them out, and they set it up again at next sign-in.

rolesPage.title: Roles & access
rolesPage.description: Choose what each role can open and do. Access is denied by default, and client data is limited to assigned accounts unless the role can see all clients. Administrators always have everything.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every sign-in, change and denied attempt. Append-only and tamper-resistant.

states.errorBody: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
states.forbiddenTitle: You don't have access to this page
states.forbiddenBody: If you need it for your work, ask a system administrator to adjust your role.
states.notFoundBody: The link may be old, or the record was archived.

validation.passwordSame: Choose a password different from the current one
validation.endAfterStart: The end must be after the start
validation.afterCurrentRate: Must be after the current rate's start date
validation.afterCurrentAllocation: Must be after the current one starts
validation.duplicateInFile: This number appears twice in the file
validation.offsets: Use numbers separated by commas, like -7, -3, 0, 1
validation.caseNeedsLink: Link this to a client or an employee
validation.noRenewalFee: This client's contract has no renewal fee. Enter an amount.
validation.creditTooHigh: The credit can't exceed what's outstanding
validation.recoverableNeedsClient: Choose the client to bill this to
validation.code: Use capital letters, numbers and underscores

errors.ownerOverlap: This client already has an owner in that date range
errors.invalidJson: Request body must be valid JSON
errors.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Slow down a little.

errors.selfDemote: You can't remove your own administrator role

errors.fileMismatch: The file content doesn't match its type
errors.fileInfected: This file was blocked by the virus scanner
errors.fileField: Send the file in a "file" form field
errors.adminOnly: Only an administrator can do this

errors.clientNeedsOwner: Assign an account owner before activating
errors.clientNeedsContract: Add an active contract before activating
errors.employeeNeedsAllocation: Place this employee on a client first
errors.importUnreadable: This file couldn't be read. Save it as .xlsx and try again.

roleDescriptions.ADMIN: Configure roles, users, master data and integrations; access audit logs
roleDescriptions.DEPT_HEAD: Department-wide records and dashboards; assigns accounts; approves escalations
roleDescriptions.ACCOUNT_MANAGER: Manages assigned clients, their employees, requests and tasks
roleDescriptions.HR: Employee records, onboarding, transfers, exits and HR cases
roleDescriptions.FINANCE: Invoices, collections, expenses, payroll cost and P&L
roleDescriptions.OPS_SUPERVISOR: Attendance and field operations, tasks and assigned cases
roleDescriptions.AUDITOR: Read-only record history and audit logs

permissions.client:read_all: View all clients regardless of assignment
permissions.client:assign: Assign account owners and support team
permissions.contract:manage: Create and edit contracts and rate cards
permissions.task:read_all: View team and department task queues
permissions.invoice:void: Void invoices and issue credit notes
permissions.payroll:manage: Import and edit payroll cost register
permissions.user:manage: Create and suspend users, assign roles
permissions.task_category:manage: Add, rename and remove task categories

access.title: Permissions for this person
access.hint: Follows their roles by default. Allow or block anything here for this person only.
access.unsavedRoles: {count, plural, =1 {Unsaved changes in 1 role} other {Unsaved changes in # roles}}
access.adminAll: Administrators always have every permission, and this can't be changed.

clients.title: Clients
clients.description: Every account, who owns it, and how it's doing.
clients.emptyBody: Add your first client to start tracking their people, cases and billing.
clients.name: Name
clients.pricingHint: Fill in the fee that matches the billing model.
clients.noContractsBody: A client needs an active contract before it can be billed.
clients.terminateBody: Billing stops using it from the next run.

employees.title: Employees
employees.addHint: They start in onboarding, with a joiner checklist.
employees.importHint: Check a whole file row by row before anything is saved.
employees.expiredDays: {days, plural, =1 {expired 1 day ago} other {expired # days ago}}
employees.emptyBody: Add one, or import your list from Excel.
employees.startExitBody: They stay on the headcount until you complete the exit.
employees.completeExitBody: Their placement ends on this day. It still counts for billing.
employees.allocationsHint: A new placement ends the current one, so history stays intact.
employees.allocateHint: Moves the employee from the date you choose.
employees.noAllocations: Not placed on a client yet
employees.compensationHint: Monthly cost basis. Only people with pay access can see this.
employees.step1Body: Column names must match. Client codes and sponsors must already exist.
employees.reviewSummary: {ok} ready, {errors} with errors. Rows with errors are skipped.
employees.expiredDays2: {days, plural, =1 {1 day late} other {# days late}}

notif.invoiceOverdue: Invoice {number} for {client} has been overdue since {date}

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Reminders and alerts for you. Acknowledge them so they don't escalate.

reminders.title: Reminder rules
reminders.description: When each reminder goes out, who gets it, and when it escalates.
reminders.whenHint: Negative is before the date: -7 is a week before, 0 is the day, 1 is a day after.
reminders.escalateHint: Hours without acknowledgement before the department head is told.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Client work and internal follow-ups, each with an owner and a date.
tasks.emptyBody: New tasks will show up here.
tasks.formHint: Pick the services first: the task's name fills in from them.
tasks.noCategories: No categories yet. Add them from Task categories.
tasks.titleAuto: Filled from the categories you pick. You can change it.
tasks.idReminder: Include the employee's name or ID number, so the request can be handled quickly and correctly.
tasks.onlyMeHint: Assigned to you and visible only to you.
tasks.holdHint: Say what it's waiting on, so others know.
tasks.financeRequiredHint: When done, it waits for Finance before closing.

cases.title: Requests & cases
cases.description: One controlled workflow for every client and employee request.
cases.severityHint: Leave blank to use the category's default.
cases.emptyBody: Log a case to start tracking it.
cases.closeHint: A resolution note is required. The full history stays on record.
cases.reopenHint: Say why. It's recorded in the case history.

escalations.title: Escalations
escalations.description: Issues needing an owner, a resolution and management visibility.
escalations.policyHint: How often management must get an update.

billing.title: Billing & collections
billing.description: Invoices, collections and what's owed to you.
billing.runsHint: Each month, turn placements into draft invoices, review them, then issue.
billing.newRunHint: Builds a draft invoice for each active client from their placements, pay and contract.
billing.noRunsBody: Start one to build this month's invoices.
billing.runEmptyBody: No active client had billable placements in this month.
billing.approveBody: You can still cancel before issuing.
billing.issueAllConfirm: Issue every invoice in this run?
billing.issueBody: They get permanent numbers and can't be edited afterwards. Corrections need a credit note.
billing.cancelRunBody: Its drafts are deleted and the month is free to run again.
billing.addInvoiceHint: For one-off charges and sponsorship renewals. Monthly invoices come from billing runs.
billing.unitAmountHint: Leave blank to use the service's price, or the contract's renewal fee.
billing.agingHint: Outstanding balance by days past due.
billing.paymentsHint: Money received, what it paid off, and what's been reconciled.
billing.emptyBody: Run billing for a month to create them.
billing.fifoHint: Applied to the oldest unpaid invoices first. Anything left stays on account.
billing.creditHint: Reduces what's owed. VAT is added to the amount you enter.
billing.voidBody: The record and its number are kept, marked void.
billing.missingPay: No pay record, so no cost was billed
billing.missingPayHint: Add their pay, then cancel this run and build it again.
billing.serviceHint: Fills the description and price from the price list. You can still change them.

finance.title: Profit & loss
finance.pnlHint: Issued revenue less direct costs, before VAT. Open months can still change.
finance.noPnlBody: They appear once invoices are issued and costs are recorded.
finance.belowTheLine: Not in the rows above: overhead {overhead}, unallocated pay {unallocated}. Both are in net profit.
finance.expensesHint: Costs for clients and for running the company. Only approved costs count.
finance.addExpenseHint: Overhead categories belong to the company, so any client chosen is ignored.
finance.clientHint: Needed for direct costs billed to a client.
finance.recoverableHint: Added to the client's next monthly invoice once approved.
finance.noExpensesBody: Add one, or change the filters.
finance.payrollHint: What staff cost each month, for P&L. This doesn't pay anyone.
finance.generateHint: Replaces any draft for this month. Someone who moved clients gets one line per client.
finance.importHint: Replaces any draft for this month. If a row has a problem, nothing changes.
finance.noPayrollBody: Build a month from pay records, or import a file.
finance.confirmBody: The month can only close once this is confirmed. You can reopen it until then.
finance.payablesHint: What the company owes, such as salaries, GOSI and fees. Reminders follow due dates.
finance.noPayablesBody: Add what's due so it isn't missed.
finance.periodsHint: Closing locks a month's expenses, payroll and invoices so its P&L stays final.
finance.closeBody: Nothing dated in it can be added or changed until someone reopens it.
finance.reopenBody: Its figures could change. This is recorded in the audit log.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Filter on screen, then export to Excel or CSV, or print. Each export is logged.
reports.noneBody: Ask an administrator if you need one.
reports.emptyBody: Try a wider range or a different client.
reports.subject: Subject
reports.hint_client-issues: Overdue money, breached cases and open escalations by client.
reports.hint_pnl-clients: Revenue, direct cost and margin for each client.
reports.hint_aging: What each client owes, by days past due.
reports.hint_invoices: Every issued invoice and credit note, by issue date.
reports.hint_headcount: Who is placed where today, with classification and sponsor.
reports.hint_documents: Employee documents expired or expiring within 90 days.
reports.hint_cases: Cases opened in the period, with stage and SLA dates.
reports.hint_expenses: Every expense in the period, approved or not.

master.description: The lists people pick from across the system. Changes apply immediately.
master.name: Name
master.caseHint: New cases take their SLA and severity from here.
master.holidayHint: Skipped when counting working hours for escalation updates.

system.clearHint: When you've finished looking around, start clean with your real data.
system.removedBody: All clients, employees, invoices, payments, expenses, payroll, cases, tasks, files and notifications, the audit log, and every other account. Invoice numbering restarts.
system.keptBody: Your account ({email}), roles and permissions, and the reference lists: regions, locations, sponsors, categories, holidays and reminder rules.
system.onceOnly: This can't be undone, and it can only be done once.
system.clearConfirmBody: This permanently deletes the data listed on this page.
system.typePhrase: Type the word exactly as shown
system.alreadyCleared: The demo data has already been cleared
system.clearedToast: Demo data cleared. The system is ready for your data.
system.clearedTitle: The demo data has been cleared
system.clearedBody: Done by {name} on {date}. Everything in the system now is real data, so this action is no longer available.

export.hint: Download this list with its current filters, all pages

priceList.description: What the company charges for each service, before VAT. Changes apply to new invoices only.
priceList.emptyBody: Add each service you offer with its price.
priceList.emptyBodyReadOnly: Finance adds services and their prices here.

taskCategories.title: Task categories
taskCategories.description: The services a task can be about. Picking one on a new task fills in its name.
taskCategories.name: Name
taskCategories.addHint: A new service people can pick
taskCategories.removeUsed: {count, plural, =1 {1 task uses it} other {# tasks use it}}, so it will be archived: those tasks keep it, and it stops appearing on new tasks. You can restore it later.
taskCategories.removeUnused: No task uses it, so it will be deleted.
taskCategories.duplicate: A category with this name already exists
taskCategories.unavailable: One of the categories is no longer available
